summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. All director nominees were re-elected with strong majority support (ranging from 90.45% to 99.16%). The auditor KPMG was reappointed (87.02% for), and the advisory vote on executive compensation passed (90.75% for). The filing notes that directors Janet Woodruff, Michael Chen, Huajie Wang resigned prior to the meeting, but this is a routine board change, not a forced or abrupt departure. This is a standard regulatory filing following an annual meeting and does not constitute a special situation.
